boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Siena University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food stops with currently posted late hours in the Loudonville–Albany area.

cards.title: Wendy’s on Central Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1335 Central Ave, Albany
cards.notes: Use the Central Avenue location when a drive-thru stop fits the plan; check the posted day-specific schedule before departing.
cards.short_summary: A Central Avenue quick-service stop with hours extending well past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-thru service until 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 1335 Central Ave.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru: 10 a.m.–3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday; 10 a.m.–4 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Wolf Road
cards.subtitle: 56 Wolf Road, Albany
cards.notes: Plan for the drive-thru after the dining room closes, and confirm the nightly schedule in the official locator before heading out.
cards.short_summary: Wolf Road tacos and burritos with drive-thru availability into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 56 Wolf Road.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 56 Wolf Road, Albany
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: 9 a.m.–1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 9 a.m.–2 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dining-room hours end earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Central Avenue
cards.subtitle: 581 Central Ave, Albany
cards.notes: Use this Central Avenue location for a late drive-thru order; the dining room has earlier hours than the drive-thru.
cards.short_summary: A separate Central Avenue Taco Bell with a documented late drive-thru schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 581 Central Ave.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 581 Central Ave, Albany
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: 9 a.m.–1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 9 a.m.–2 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: 24-Hour Dunkin’ at Albany Med
cards.subtitle: 43 New Scotland Ave, Albany
cards.notes: For an around-the-clock coffee or snack stop, use the Albany Med location and allow extra time for the trip from Loudonville.
cards.short_summary: A Dunkin’ location whose official locator posts 24-hour daily operation.
cards.evidence_claim: Dunkin’ lists its Albany Medical Center location at 43 New Scotland Ave as open 24 hours every day.
cards.source_title: Dunkin' at 43 New Scotland Ave, Albany
cards.access_notes: Official hours are 24 hours Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Chipotle on Wolf Road
cards.subtitle: 105 Wolf Road, Albany
cards.notes: Order ahead or use in-store pickup during posted hours; this is a dinner-to-late-evening option, not an overnight stop.
cards.short_summary: Wolf Road burritos, bowls, tacos, and salads served until 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Chipotle lists restaurant hours of 10:45 a.m.–11 p.m. daily for its 105 Wolf Road location.
cards.source_title: Chipotle Mexican Grill at 105 Wolf Road, Albany
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours are 10:45 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday through Sunday; pickup is available during store hours.

cards.entity_name: Chipotle Mexican Grill, 17 New Scotland Ave
cards.title: Chipotle on New Scotland Avenue
cards.subtitle: 17 New Scotland Ave, Albany
cards.notes: Use the New Scotland Avenue location for a later dinner pickup; place an order within the restaurant’s posted operating window.
cards.short_summary: A New Scotland Avenue Chipotle with service listed until 11 p.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Chipotle lists restaurant hours of 10:45 a.m.–11 p.m. daily for its 17 New Scotland Ave location.
cards.source_title: Chipotle Mexican Grill at 17 New Scotland Ave, Albany
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours are 10:45 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday through Sunday; pickup and delivery are listed as available.

cards.title: PizzaRoni on Madison Avenue
cards.subtitle: 420 Madison Ave, Albany
cards.notes: Choose pickup or delivery from the Madison Avenue shop, and review its ordering page for the current closing time before placing an order.
cards.short_summary: Independent pizza shop listing service until 3 a.m. on its ordering page.
cards.evidence_claim: PizzaRoni’s ordering page lists hours of 10 a.m.–3 a.m. at 420 Madison Ave in Albany.
cards.access_notes: The official ordering page lists 10 a.m.–3 a.m.; verify availability when ordering, as service modes can change.

cards.title: Soho Pizza on Lark Street
cards.subtitle: 269 Lark St, Albany
cards.notes: Call or order ahead for a late pizza pickup or delivery; use the official posted daily hours to time the visit.
cards.short_summary: Lark Street pizza shop listing late-night hours every day of the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Soho Pizza lists hours until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 269 Lark St.
cards.access_notes: Hours: 10 a.m.–2 a.m. Monday–Thursday, 10 a.m.–3 a.m. Friday, 11 a.m.–3 a.m. Saturday, and 11 a.m.–2 a.m. Sunday.

cards.title: Westgate Pizza Bella
cards.subtitle: 911 Central Ave, Albany
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s official ordering channel for a Central Avenue pizza or sub stop, and verify which posted schedule is active that day.
cards.short_summary: Central Avenue pizza shop whose site lists closing times from 1 to 4:30 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Westgate Pizza Bella’s site lists late-night operating hours, including 2 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and later Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: The site posts one schedule ending 2 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday, 4:30 a.m. Thursday, and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday; confirm before travel.

cards.title: Legends Pizza on Wolf Road
cards.subtitle: 98 Wolf Road, Unit 6, Albany
cards.notes: For a Wolf Road pizza, pasta, burger, or sub order, confirm the nightly closing time on Legends Pizza’s official site before leaving.
cards.short_summary: Independent Wolf Road pizza restaurant open until midnight or 1 a.m., depending on day.
cards.evidence_claim: Legends Pizza lists hours of 10 a.m.–midnight Sunday–Thursday and 10 a.m.–1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Hours posted: 10 a.m.–midnight Sunday–Thursday and 10 a.m.–1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
